# Get in touch {{< fa feather-pointed >}}

You can use this form to contact me about research collaborations, speaking engagements, bioinformatics questions, or simply to say hello.

I'm always interested in connecting with researchers, students, and colleagues interested in bioinformatics and computational biology.
